title: Look it up, don't make it up.
tagline: Agents fetch facts instead of recalling them.

steps.comment: # what does the movies collection look like?
steps.note: Discover first, so the write targets real fields.

steps.comment: # create from a reference record — facts come from WikiData, not from a guess
steps.command:
skeem create movies --enrich wikidata:items:Q83495 \
  --map label=title --map description=overview --map externalIds.imdb=imdb_id --json
steps.note: enrichedFrom / enrichedFields make the provenance auditable. Your explicit fields would always win.
